notes: Every helper's page is new: one way in, then each one works its own way. Skills on every step, and chats that sit beside the page while it updates.

whatsnew.title: Every helper has a new page.
whatsnew.line: Business Development, Customer Care and Content walk you one step at a time. Creative Director is a wall of shelves. Operations and Funnel sit in an orb.

whatsnew.title: Skills on every step.
whatsnew.line: Each step and page has buttons for its jobs, like Scan for new people or Find the biggest drop. Tap one and the helper starts.

whatsnew.title: Chats sit beside the page.
whatsnew.line: The page moves over to make room, and redraws after every reply, so you watch the change land.

whatsnew.title: A Today card on every page.
whatsnew.line: The one thing that needs you, with Show me or Later.

changes.title: Every helper page is rebuilt: the same way in from the wheel, then One step at a time (Business Development, Customer Care, Content), The wall (Creative Director) or The orb (Operations, Funnel), with a Today card on each
changes.plain: Each helper's page is cleaner, and each one works in the way that suits its job.
changes.notice: Open any helper from the wheel and you land on one clear Today card, then that helper's own layout.

changes.title: Skills on every pipeline step and on Brand DNA, the Codes, the Offer and ICP: tap one and the helper starts that job in a chat
changes.plain: Buttons for each job, right on the step or page it belongs to.
changes.notice: On a step like Discovered you'll see Scan for new people; tap it and the chat starts.

changes.title: While a chat is open the page moves over to sit beside it, and redraws after every reply
changes.plain: You see the page change while you talk.
changes.notice: Open a chat and the page slides left instead of hiding behind it.

changes.title: Your Personal Assistant, Council and six helpers answer out loud, each in their own voice, made free on your computer: hold the mic (or Space) to talk, let go to send, hold again to cut in, close the chat to stop
A Coach joins your Council (the sunrise door): you pick your areas, it builds your daily few in your Notion and holds you to it
Update inside your hub: a quick reload for hub-only updates; for team updates your hub runs the update itself while Operations shows each step, then What's new
Team mailbox: helpers ask each other, share news and hand over hub ideas, right in your hub
Every chat starts already in the loop: the hub hands each helper its unread updates and open questions
Ideas you drop in passing get caught and sent to the right helper, and you see it happen
Only real blockers reach you, once a day, from your Personal Assistant; asks left open 2 days move on by themselves
Operations fits hub ideas in: Add to your hub?, backed up first, with Undo
Recos stay tidy: picked ones move to In progress, close themselves when done, and old ones are marked outdated with Keep or Let go
The Front Desk is now your Personal Assistant
